workflow: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of physical objects, including smartphones, laptops, and home appliances, connected to the internet and able to communicate with each other. It enables users to control and monitor devices remotely, and allows for system scalability, customization, and automation capabilities. IoT allows users to track, automate and optimize device performance and energy usage, offering new levels of efficiency and productivity.
